summary: Loads MPCDI calibration files and outputs region/grid calibration textures while exposing projection and cameraTransform members for Camera COMP integration.

key_params.name: layoutmax
key_params.note: Grid layout size components layoutmaxw and layoutmaxh

common_gotchas: Invalid bufferid or regionid values can produce an empty or wrong calibration output.
Grid output depends on layoutmaxw and layoutmaxh, not only the outputformat menu.
Camera COMP integration requires the projection and cameraTransform Python members, not just the texture output.
Alpha-beta and gamma toggles must match how the MPCDI calibration file was authored.
key_concepts: Loads projection calibration data from .mpcdi files.
Can output a single region or lay regions out in grid rows or grid columns.
Buffer ID and Region ID select which calibration region is emitted.
projection and cameraTransform Python members feed Camera COMP setup for MPCDI calibration.
Alpha-beta blending and gamma encoding apply MPCDI calibration corrections.
